summary.text: Bo Whitehead, a Green Party warehouse supervisor, lost the November 3, 2026 election for North Carolina's 8th Congressional District to Mark Harris.
A first-time candidate, he moved to the Charlotte area about three years ago from Georgia, according to WFAE.

paragraphs.text: WFAE describes Whitehead as 33 years old and a warehouse supervisor who lived in Georgia before moving to the Charlotte area about three years ago; he lives in Pineville.
In a WFAE questionnaire he says he was homeschooled, received a GED, and holds prior CDL and Hazmat transport certifications.
He has no previous experience in elected office and says he is the primary caretaker for his wife.
During the campaign, he said he wanted to represent the working class.
He received 1% of the vote to Mark Harris's 50.4%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
